name: tsgh-clinical-notes
description: Personal TSGH-aligned inpatient clinical documentation and holistic-care assessment workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Draft TSGH clinical notes and holistic-care assessments.
interface.longDescription: A personal, instruction-only plugin that bundles TSGH-aligned admission, progress, weekly, discharge, and operation-note workflows plus a Chinese B/P/Sc/Sp/E/P/D holistic-care assessment template. Use only with authorized, minimum-necessary clinical information and clinician review.
defaultPrompt: Draft an admission note from these supplied facts.
Draft a discharge summary from this hospitalization.
Draft a Chinese B/P/Sc/Sp/E/P/D holistic-care assessment from these supplied records.
